subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Dr. Sun-Hee Jeon is an urban sociologist.
• She conducted a study of commuting patterns in Portland's downtown district.
• She wanted to know how the availability of bike lanes affects commuters' choice of transportation in that area.
• She found that during months when new bike lanes were added, bicycle commuting increased by 35% compared to previous periods.
• The new bike lanes, which were protected from vehicle traffic, provided safer routes than existing bike infrastructure.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the aim of the research study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Analyzing commuting data, Jeon found that during months when new bike lanes were added, bicycle commuting increased by 35% compared to previous periods.
choices.B: Jeon's study revealed that commuters were drawn to protected bike lanes that provided safer routes than existing infrastructure.
choices.C: Jeon, an urban sociologist, studied commuting patterns in Portland's downtown district, where many people commute daily.
choices.D: In her study, Jeon sought to determine how the availability of bike lanes affects commuters' choice of transportation in Portland's downtown district.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the aim, or goal, of the research study, noting that Jeon sought to determine how bike lane availability affects commuters' choice of transportation.
